title: 46 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Hobbies & Free Time)
description:
Learn 46 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 46 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Hobbies & Free Time · 爱好与休闲
1:25  Inner Peace · 内心平静
2:46  Self Improvement · 自我提升
3:56  Cultural Traditions · 文化传统
5:07  Daily Routine · 日常生活
6:20  Creativity · 创造力
7:48  Mindfulness · 正念
9:17  Perseverance · 毅力

PHRASE LIST

HOBBIES & FREE TIME · 爱好与休闲
• I unwind with guitar at night. - 晚上我弹吉他放松一下。  [WanSHANG wo TAN jI ta fANG sōng yī xià.]
• I sketch in cafés on Sundays. - 周日我在咖啡馆速写。  [Zhōu rì wo zài kā fēi guǎn sù xiě.]
• I take slow walks with podcasts. - 我边散步边听播客。  [Wo biān sàn bù biān tīng bō kè.]
• I volunteer at the animal shelter. - 我去动物收容所做志愿者。  [Wo qù dòng wù shōu róng suǒ zuò zhì yuàn zhě.]
• I practice Chinese cooking sauces. - 我练习做中式蘸料和酱汁。  [Wo liàn xí zuò zhōng shì zhàn liào hé jiàng zhī.]
• I binge foreign films with subtitles. - 我用字幕追外语电影。  [Wo yòng zì mù zhuī wài yǔ diàn yǐng.]

INNER PEACE · 内心平静
• I breathe, then soften my attention. - 我先呼吸，再把注意放软。  [Wo xiān hūxī, zài bǎ zhùyì fàng ruǎn.]
• Let your jaw unclench right now. - 现在就把紧咬的牙放松下来。  [Xiànzài jiù bǎ jǐn yǎ de yá fàngsōng xiàlái.]
• I choose curiosity over worry. - 我选择好奇，不选担心。  [Wo xuǎnzé hǎoqí, bù xuǎn dānxīn.]
• Soft eyes, steady heart, calm. - 眼睛放柔，心稳下来，安静就有了。  [Yǎnjing fàng róu, xīn wěn xiàlái, ānjìng jiù yǒu le.]
• I turn down the inner volume. - 我把内心的音量调小。  [Wo bǎ nèixīn de yīnláng tiáo xiǎo.]
• I slow my thoughts on purpose. - 我有意放慢念头的速度。  [Wo yǒu yì fàngmàn niàntou de sùdù.]

SELF IMPROVEMENT · 自我提升
• Train your attention, not just words. - 训练你的注意力，而不只是单词。  [Xùnliàn nǐ de zhùyìlì, ér bù shì zhǐ dānzì.]
• Make mistakes, then fix one thing. - 先犯错，再改正一个问题。  [Xiān fàncuò, zài gǎizhèng yí gè wèntí.]
• Slow down to hear real tone. - 放慢一点，才能听准真实的声调。  [Fàngmàn yìdiǎn, cái néng tīng zhǔn zhēnshí de shēngdiào.]
• Turn confusion into a question. - 把困惑变成一个问题。  [Bǎ kùnhuò biàn chéng yí gè wèntí.]
• Write it once, then speak it. - 先写一遍，再用嘴说出来。  [Xiān xiě yí biàn, zài yòng zuǐ shuō chūlái.]

CULTURAL TRADITIONS · 文化传统
• Serve tea when you visit - 来做客也要先敬茶  [Lái zuòkè yě yào xiān JÌNG chá]
• At weddings, share long noodles - 婚礼上吃长寿面，寓意长久  [Hūn lǐ shàng chī cháng shòu miàn, yùyì chángjiǔ]
• On birthdays, cut a lucky cake - 过生日要切蛋糕，大家一起许愿  [Guò shēngrì yào qiē dàn gāo, dàjiā yìqǐ xǔyuàn]
• Make dumplings for family time - 包饺子是一家人团聚的好时光  [Bāo jiǎo zi shì yī jiā rén tuánjù de hǎo shíguāng]
• Eat tangyuan for togetherness - 汤圆煮好了，一家人团团圆圆  [Tāngyuán zhǔ hǎo le, yījiā rén tuán tuán yuán yuán]

DAILY ROUTINE · 日常生活
• I heat leftovers for lunch - 我把午餐的剩菜热一下。  [Wo ba wu can de sheng cai re yi xia.]
• I fill up my water bottle - 我给水瓶灌满水。  [Wo gei shui ping guan man shui.]
• I grab breakfast on the go - 我边走边随便吃点早餐。  [Wo bian zou bian sui bian chi dian zao can.]
• I check the weather before heading out - 我出门前看下天气。  [Wo chu men qian kan xia tian qi.]
• I answer emails first thing - 我一到就先回邮件。  [Wo yi dao jiu xian hui mei ti.]
• I take a short walk at lunch - 我午休时出去走走。  [Wo wu xiu shi chu qu zou zou.]

CREATIVITY · 创造力
• Mix routines, get fresh ideas - 把老流程换个顺序,灵感就来了  [bǎ lǎo liúchéng huàn gè shùnxù, LÍNGGǔN jiù lái le]
• Try one tiny twist today - 今天只做一个小小改动,就有惊喜  [jīntiān zhǐ zuò yí gè xiǎoxiao gǎidòng, jiù yǒu jīngxǐ]
• Make constraints your superpower - 限制越明确,创意越好用  [xiànzhì yuè míngquè, chuàngyì yuè hǎo yòng]
• Borrow form, change the meaning - 换个表达形式,意思一样也能新  [huàn gè biǎodá xíngshì, yìsi yíyàng yě néng xīn]
• Turn silence into a draft - 先不说,写下几句空白也算开始  [xiān bù shuō, xiě xià jǐ jù kōngbái yě suàn kāishǐ]
• Describe feelings, not objects - 与其描物,不如先写你的感受  [yǔqí miáo wù, bú rú xiān xiě nǐ de gǎnshòu]

MINDFULNESS · 正念
• Feel your shoulders lift, then drop - 让肩膀先抬起，再放松落下  [ràng jiān bǎng xiān tái qǐ, zài fàng sōng luò xià]
• Notice your tongue, resting softly - 留意舌头的位置，轻轻放松  [liúyì shé tou de wèizhi, qīng qīng fàng sōng]
• Relax your forehead, unclench the face - 放松额头，别再用力皱脸  [fàng sōng é tóu, bié zài yòng lì zhòu liǎn]
• Hear the room, not the story - 听这个空间的声音，别急着讲故事  [tīng zhè ge kōngjiān de shēngyīn, bié jí zhe jiǎng gùshi]
• Notice judgment, name it gently - 当你评判起来，就轻轻说一声评判  [dāng nǐ píngpàn qǐlái, jiù qīng qīng shuō yì shēng píngpàn]
• Choose one sound and follow it - 挑一个声音跟着它，慢慢听下去  [tiāo yí ge shēngyīn gēn zhe tā, mànmàn tīng xià qù]

PERSEVERANCE · 毅力
• Crack it, then keep working - 先啃下来，再继续磨  [xiān kěn xiàlái, zài jìxù mó]
• When you miss a day, reset - 断了一天也没关系，立刻接上  [duàn le yì tiān yě méi guānxi, lìkè jiēshàng]
